book.name: Naꞌ Markus
book.title: Aꞌan Alekot matoom neu Usif Jesus, natuin Naꞌ Markus in sulat

content: Usif Jesus natoon nani, nak Uim Onen Uuf lof anluin

Oke te, Jesus nok In asium-noinaꞌ sin nnaon nasaitan Uim Onen Uuf. Olas sin nnaon mpoin, In asium-noinaꞌ es nalekan Uim Onen nane nak, “Amaꞌ, ati mail miit ije feꞌ! Ume ii alekot! Sin mbakin fatu ii alekot!”
Mes Jesus natae mnak, “Ume ii, namneo namaas! Mes lof neka ntee ꞌloꞌo, sin naꞌleꞌun nain baki ii ok-okeꞌ.”
Takaf-takaf neu neno amsouput

Oke te, Jesus sin nnaon mbinuk aꞌnuꞌaf Oliveira, ma ntook mbi bale leꞌ manꞌailan nok Uim Onen Uuf nane. Nalail, In asium-noinaꞌ sin haaꞌ neman namolok nok Ne. Es leꞌ naꞌ Pedru, naꞌ Yakobus, naꞌ Joao, ma naꞌ Andreas.
Sin ntotin mnak, “Amaꞌ! Ati mutonan mtein kai molok leꞌ alelo. Lof lekaꞌ niꞌ in neno amsouput antee? Ma nok in takaf-takaf nane, on mee?”
Oke te, Jesus natae mnak, “Ilamu hi mpao ma mpanat lek-leok, he kaisa naꞌloep ki.
Fun natuin lofa nmuiꞌ atoni humaꞌ-humaꞌ leꞌ neem mpeꞌas ansaon nak, ‘Au leꞌ ije, Kristus. Uisneno nleek nani kau naꞌko unuꞌ.’ Nalail sin naꞌmoeꞌ atoni namfau.
Kalu hi mail atoni makenan, aiꞌ hi mneen uab anin humaꞌ-humaꞌ nak, nmuiꞌ makenat mbi mee-mee, hi kaisa mimtau. Fun natuin lasi on leꞌ nane, musti he mbool, mes neno amsouput feꞌ ka nteef.

Suku es nmakeen nok suku bian. Pah es nmakeen nok pah bian. Nmuiꞌ nai-nunus mbeko mbi mee-mee. Ma amnahas manenuꞌ ambool mbi mee-mee! Leꞌ ii ok-okeꞌ njael takaf, namnees on leꞌ bifee aꞌaput nameen nabool he nahoin.

Es on nane te, hi musti mpao lek-leok! Fun natuin lofa sin neman nhuuk ki ma nheel neik ki nnao neu uim afeek lasi akama. Ma sin nteop ki mbi uim onen-uim onen. Ma sin lof nfuut neik ki nnao neu aan aplenat, natuin hi mituin Kau. Mes nane njael sonaꞌ henati hi mitoon neu sin matoom neu Kau.
Fun Uisneno In atoni musti nnao nahuun henati natoon Au Laes Alekot neu suku ok-okeꞌ mbi pah-pinan ije, niꞌ neno amsouput nane ntee.

Mimnau! Kalu sin anfuut neik ki nnao neu afeek lasi, hi kaisa mimtau mak, ‘Au uꞌuab ꞌak saaꞌ? Aiꞌ, au uꞌtae ꞌak saaꞌ?’ Kalu in olas he ntee, hi miꞌuab mituina saaꞌ es Uisneno In Smana Kninoꞌ natoon ki.

Mbi uum jes, kalu nmuiꞌ atoni es npalsai neu Kau, in olif-tataf sin es namin lalan he naꞌmaet ee. Ma kalu in aanh es anpalsai, in aamf aa kuun es neik noon kuun he naꞌmaet ee. Ma kalu in enaf-amaf anpalsai Kau, in aanh in es naꞌmaet sin.
Lof anmuiꞌ atoni he natoꞌan ki, fun hi mpalsai neu Kau. Mes sikau es ansutai tala neno amsouput ije nfiin, lof Uisneno nfee ꞌhonis neu ne.”
Mpao ma mpanat, fun neno amsouput he nhaumaken!

Jesus naꞌuab piut mnak, “Atoni amaunut nneis lofa neem. In ntaam ma nhaek mbi bael nuni mbi Uisneno In Uim Onen Uuf, leꞌ ka maꞌotaꞌ fa neu ne, tala in nhaꞌniis bale nane. Es nane te, Uisneno nnao nasaitan bale nane. Kalu hi miit on nane, mpanat lek-leok, he! (Sikau es anlee leꞌ ije, musti sintilu msat!) Nane njael takaf nak neon asusal ntee enoꞌ neusn aa be. Kalu miit milail on nane, atoni mbi profinsia Judea musti nfeen ma naen nnaon neu nuk ꞌnuuꞌf aa nai.
Ma sin musti naen sabake, he kais napenin silakaꞌ. Kalu atoni mpoi nalail naꞌko ume, kaisa nfain naiti ntein baleꞌ nai.
Ma atoni leꞌ mbi lele, kaisa nfain nait tainusat nai. Sin musti naen piut!
Kasian neu leꞌ bifeel aꞌaput, ma neu bifeel leꞌ asuus liꞌanaꞌ meꞌe. Fun sin naenan ka nabeꞌin faꞌ.
Es nane te, naleko nneis, hi mꞌonen mtoit henati leꞌ lais amleꞌut nane, kaisa neem nateef nok olas ulan-anin.
Fun olas nane, susal aꞌnaek! Naꞌko Uisneno nmoeꞌ pah-pinan ii, tal antee muni ii, atoni feꞌ ka niit leꞌ susal aꞌnaek on leꞌ nane. Ma lof atoni ka niit antein fa susal on nane.
Kalu Uisneno ka naꞌpalan neon susal nane, lofa ka nmuiꞌ fa atoni es nsutai he nmoin. Mes, fun Uisneno nneek atoni leꞌ In nleek sin, nane natuin In naꞌpalan neon susal nane.
Kalu neno nane ntele, hi mneen atoni sin nak, ‘Mail feꞌ! Kristus es ii!’ Mes atoni bian nak, ‘Kristus es nae!’ Mes hi kaisa mneen maan sin uab nane!

Lofa nmuiꞌ atoni mpoi, ma nteop ansaon nak, ‘Au leꞌ ije, Kristus!’ Atoni bian naꞌuab am nak, ‘Au leꞌ ije, Uisneno In mafefaꞌ es leꞌ au.’ Lofa sin nmoeꞌ lasi takaf humaꞌ-humaꞌ neik pah-tuaf in kuasan he naꞌmoeb atoni. Sin namin lalan he naꞌloep atoni Uisneno msat, mes ka nabeiꞌ fa!
Mes hi musti mpaant om lek-leok! Neno-neno asusal feꞌ kan mbool, mes Au uꞌtoon ꞌain neu ki!”
Aan Mansian In amneman
Nalali te, Jesus natoon piut neu In asium-noinaꞌ sin mnak, “Kalu neon susal anfiin,

content.text: ma kuasat mbi neno tunan nasiit-bokan.’

content: Oke te, niꞌ atoni ok-okeꞌ niit Kau, Aan Mansian leꞌ ii. Lofa Au oum uꞌko neno tunan. Ma atoni ok-okeꞌ lof sin niit Au kuasak, ma Au ꞌlekok!
Nalali te, Au uplenat Uisneno In ameput neno tunan, he nnaon nabuab atoni ok-okeꞌ leꞌ Au ꞌleek ꞌain sin naꞌko pah-pinan in kantu haaꞌ sin, naꞌko neon-saet tala ntee neno-moufun.”
Neno-neno asusal njael takaf neu Usif Jesus In amneman
Nalali te, Jesus natoon piut nak, “Au ꞌaiti laes letaꞌ naꞌko haub. Kalu haub in nonan nmolok, nane takaf nak faok-nais he nhaumaak en.
On nane msat, kalu hi miit milail neon susal neem, namnees on leꞌ alelo Au utoon ki, nane takaf nak Au ꞌpaumaak he ꞌoum en.
Mitniin lek-leok! Naꞌko atoni ok-okeꞌ leꞌ ii, lofa nmuiꞌ bian feꞌ ka nmaten, mes neno asusal nane ntele.
Masti neno tunan ma pah-pinan namneuk ma namsaab, mes Au aꞌan leꞌ ii ka namnekuf ma ka namsabaf, mes nabal-baal.”
Usif Jesus olas he nfain neem, nane maꞌnifaꞌ

Nalali te, Jesus namolok piut nak, “Ka nmuiꞌ fa atoni meseꞌ he nahiin nak lekaꞌ Au olas ntee he Au ꞌfain ꞌoum. Uisneno In ameput mbi neno tunan msat, ka nahinan fa. Au msat, ka uhiin fa. Alahaa Au Amaꞌ anmees kuun, es nahiin.
Fun on nane te, hi musti mpao ma mpanat lek-leok, fun hi ka mihiin fa leka te in olas ntee.

Ka ꞌloꞌo fa ben, Au ꞌnao usaitan ki, mes lof Au ꞌfain ꞌoum. Namnees on leꞌ atoni nnao nasaitan in ume, he nnao on pah aꞌloob. In nleul in ameupt in he nail ume ma naꞌmeꞌu. Ma in nbaet sin mepu he es-esat nail kuun in mepu. In nak apao ꞌeno henati mpao lek-leok tala in nfain neem.

Hi amsat musti mpao faij-manas, fun hi ka mihiin fa leka te uim tuaf nane nfain neem. He neem nok neon mabe ka, aiꞌ faij aa natnaan ka, aiꞌ maans aa naheun ka, aiꞌ maans aa mpeeꞌ ka. Hi ka mihiin maan fa leka te uim tuaf nane nfain neem.
Kais-kais in neem nok askeken, ma napein naan ki mtuup ka mbeꞌaf.

Saaꞌ es leꞌ Au utonan ꞌain ki leꞌ ii, Au utonan neu atoni bian amsat, ꞌak, ‘Hi musti mpanat lek-leok he mseun Au mnemak.’ ” [Nheubah leꞌ nane, Usif Jesus namolok nok In asium-noinaꞌ sin mbi ꞌnuꞌaf Oliveira.]
